main_text.p: retur evulsus Papa ex solo Anglicano, atque superiori seculo cimeriae tenebrae Papismi ex Anglia pulsae, essent per claram Evangelii Lucem, quae nihil usquam, nec caliginis, nec faecis Romanensis reliquit in Anglia, quale est aequior opinio de Papa quam de Antichristo & filio perditionis; attamen, hoc demum seculo emersisse aliquot tutelares Papae genios inter primarios Ecclesiae Anglicanae viros Archiepiscopum Laudum, Montacutum, Hamondum, aliosque, qui, descisentes a puritate priorum reformatorum, adeoque studentes se amiciores Papae probare, pertinaciter ore & in scriptis suis pertenderent, quaecunque in Apocalypsi intelliguntur a defaecatioris reformationis vindicibus de Papa Antichristo,

page.notes: Faint show-through at lower left ("deluit") and right-edge Google watermark not transcribed. Some words in the scan are slightly blurred; the reading "descisentes" and "defaecatioris" are as printed as far as legible. Page number printed as "(63)" in a decorative form; read as 163 with some doubt.
